# Split Screen

iOS 15 +

## Notes

Split screen two apps

## Syntax

~~~~text
splitScreen(appOne: <#App#>, appTwo: <#App#>, ratio: <#Dynamic Enum (WFAppRatio) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
splitScreen(appOne: com.zlineman.jellyfish, appTwo: com.zlineman.jellyfish, ratio: half)
~~~~
